description: Pack seven connected Soma pieces into an autonomously drifting three-dimensional cradle, correcting the inertial alignment motor throughout each seating operation.
name: Polycube Parcel V2 · Difficulty 1 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Fill the moving 3×3×3 parcel with all seven rigid Soma pieces. Select and rotate pieces, inspect the volume and depth slices, then release the cradle. Click the X/Y motor plane and Z depth rail; click SEAT to begin seating. The motor has inertia. Stay inside the moving alignment halo on all three axes until the piece seats. A missed seat, collision or lost alignment ends the attempt. Certify only when all 27 cells are filled. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.
